title: If you drag an item on Desktop, hold right-click, then drop the file, the "grabbing glove" cursor is incorrectly shown
line: Dropping a dragged item while another mouse button is held now shows the normal pointer right away instead of the grabbing hand.
explanation: During a drag KWin shows its own drag cursor (the grabbing hand), and it only switches back when something re-evaluates the cursor source. When the drag ends, the pointer focus update is blocked while any button is still pressed, so with the right button held nothing re-evaluated the cursor and the hand stayed until that button was released. The change makes the cursor re-evaluate as soon as the drag ends, so it falls back to the normal arrow immediately and picks up the window's cursor once the button is released.

commits.message:
pointer_input: update the cursor when a drag ends

If another button was still held when a drag was dropped, the cursor
kept the drag's grabbing hand until that button was released, since
nothing re-evaluated it. Re-evaluate the cursor as soon as a drag ends.

BUG: 518880

patches.diff:
From 27cc2d1252bdf884031124f5be15c1412ecd5aa0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:42:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] pointer_input: update the cursor when a drag ends

If another button was still held when a drag was dropped, the cursor
kept the drag's grabbing hand until that button was released, since
nothing re-evaluated it. Re-evaluate the cursor as soon as a drag ends.

BUG: 518880
---
 src/pointer_input.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/src/pointer_input.cpp b/src/pointer_input.cpp
index 954d8f5d30..904bf8b8d4 100644
--- a/src/pointer_input.cpp
+++ b/src/pointer_input.cpp
@@ -1060,6 +1060,7 @@ CursorImage::CursorImage(PointerInputRedirection *parent)
         connect(waylandServer()->seat()->dragSource(), &AbstractDataSource::acceptedChanged, this, &CursorImage::updateDragCursor);
         reevaluteSource();
     });
+    connect(waylandServer()->seat(), &SeatInterface::dragEnded, this, &CursorImage::reevaluteSource);
 
     PointerInterface *pointer = waylandServer()->seat()->pointer();
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: x.txt dragged and dropped with the right button still held; the pointer stays the grabbing hand.
Patched KWin, same steps: the pointer is the normal arrow right after the drop while the right button is still held.
